findings.title: KeyError when installation metadata lacks sender
findings.body: The user mismatch check dereferences integration.metadata["sender"]["login"] unconditionally. Integrations created by build_integration without state["sender"] (or existing rows from before sender was recorded) will have no "sender" key in metadata. On the reinstallation path where the Integration exists but no OrganizationIntegration exists, this raises KeyError and returns a 500/Internal Error instead of the GitHub integration failure page. Use integration.metadata.get("sender", {}).get("login") and fail closed if it is missing.

findings.title: GitHub user validation skipped when Integration does not exist yet
findings.body: In GitHubInstallation.dispatch, when Integration.objects.get(external_id=installation_id) raises DoesNotExist, the code returns pipeline.next_step() before comparing pipeline.fetch_state("github_authenticated_user") to the installation's sender. For a first-time installation (or if the installation webhook has not yet created the Integration row), pipeline.next_step() proceeds to build_integration and creates the integration without any sender-vs-OAuth-user check. An attacker who can reach the setup URL with a valid installation_id and complete OAuth as a different GitHub user can attach that installation to their Sentry organization. The check should not be conditional on the Integration row already existing; the sender must be obtained elsewhere or installation should fail closed.

findings.title: get_user_info exceptions escape OAuthLoginView
findings.body: The token-response parsing around safe_urlread is wrapped in try/except, but get_user_info(payload["access_token"]) is not. get_user_info makes an HTTP request to GitHub and can raise on network failures, timeouts, non-JSON bodies, or HTTP errors that it does not convert to a plain missing-login dict. Because dispatch does not catch these exceptions, a valid pipeline can return a 500 instead of rendering the installation failure page. Wrap get_user_info in an error-handling block and return error(request, self.active_organization) when the user cannot be fetched.
